subject: [PATCH 2/2] firmware: arm_sdei_nmi: Send the backtrace IPI to CPUs with SDEI masked

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch series addresses an issue where CPUs with SDEI masked are not sending backtraces due to the regular IPI being blocked. The fix involves modifying the sdei_nmi_fire function to send an IPI to these CPUs instead, allowing them to participate in the backtrace process.
